UPSSSC Forensic Science Laboratory Eligibility Result 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released The Eligibility Result for the recruitment of Forensic Science Laboratory on its official website. This recruitment was released for 208 posts. Applications for the UPSSSC Forensic Science Laboratory Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 27 July 2026, to 24 August 2026. Candidates who had appeared in this Examination can download their UPSSSC Forensic Science Laboratory Eligibility Result 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 27 July 2026
  • Last Date : 24 August 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 24 August 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 24 August 2026
  • Eligibility Result : 27 August 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card Available : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 25/-
  • SC, ST, Candidates : Rs. 25/-
  • PH Candidates: Rs. 25/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
